title: Great ride
text: The driver was on time, courteous and pointed out points of interest in Barcelona on the way to the airport.
author: Susan_M

title: The opposite of the arrival transfer
text: The driver met us outside the hotel well in advance, very polite and helpful. Smooth ride to the airport, quite the opposite to the arrival experience.
author: Michael_B

title: This was well worth the cost.  The...
text: This was well worth the cost. The driver was where he said he would be as expected. We had the same driver on the way out of Barcelona as we did when we flew in. We got stuck in Barcelona traffic so we were happy the car company built in extra time for us so there was no worrying! We highly recommend this company.
author: Katrina T
